changes.description: [V3] When Workflows are enabled, a workflow now starts only when you explicitly ask for one
`/tools` lists each tool with one labelled line per field when the screen reader setting is on, so screen readers announce Source, Status and Description
`kiro-cli mcp add --agent` now grants the new server to agents whose `tools` list lacks it, and upgrades the agent file for V3 when `chat.enableAutoAgentUpgrade` is on
[V3] Resuming a V2 session now tells you its saved tool approvals weren't carried over and how to keep approvals in V3
[V3] Compaction retries without images when the model rejects history images
[V3] MCP sign-in no longer leaves a pinned OAuth callback port occupied afterward
[V3] Unavailable optional power MCP servers no longer block prompt turns
[V3] Long image sessions omit older images to stay within the request limit
[V3] Workflow plan approvals open with the first offered option highlighted, so Enter selects it
HTML doctypes and tag brackets in code previews use theme colors with readable contrast
[V3] Custom agents running as subagents can search their own knowledge bases
[V3] MCP servers added from the registry launch the catalog's package version again
[V3] Messages sent after a spec task run can keep updating its tasks
[V3] Agents that use `@builtin` now include web search, as in V2
[V3] Dispatched subagents now load their own skills instead of the parent agent's skills
[V3] User agents keep their file allow and deny rules when a session starts in the home folder
[V3] Kiro asks you to trust a folder before it loads that folder's hooks, agents, MCP servers or workflows
[V3] Workflow plan approvals show a compact step tree with expandable details
Faster `grep` tool searches on large projects: files are now scanned in parallel across CPU cores
Mermaid flowcharts with subgraphs now draw in chat instead of showing their source
[V3] Long sessions hold less memory, so the agent stays responsive after hours of use
[V3] Workflow GitHub PR watches now act on merge conflicts, failed checks, and answered threads
[V3] Terminal title shows the session title when `chat.terminalTitle` is enabled
[V3] Replies Kiro starts on its own, such as after a workflow finishes, no longer cut off after a few words
[V3] `/agent`, `/model`, and `/effort` complete a partly typed argument inline again
[V3] Editing sandbox network rules in `permissions.yaml` now applies to the running sandbox
[V3] `/sessions` no longer freezes for seconds at a time while its search index catches up
[V3] Fallback models can be set again from the `/model` pane and `/model fallback`
Clearer Mermaid node descriptions wrap across up to four rows, with an ellipsis for longer text
Starting Kiro from your home directory no longer lists your global agents twice
[V3] In your home directory, `/sandbox` no longer treats your global sandbox settings as project settings, so changing project settings there can't overwrite or delete them
[V3] `kiro-cli chat --agent <agent> @agent-sop:<name>` runs the SOP instead of sending the text as typed, also with `--no-interactive`
[V3] Cloud config keeps syncing after a request that never gets an answer
[V3] `/code` in cloud sessions shows the sandbox workspace root and `lsp.json` path
[V3] Sessions no longer show a cloud config sync card when your cloud config is empty
[V3] The `code` tool reports diagnostics from Python and other slow language servers
[V3] Throttling errors now tell an overloaded model apart from your own rate limit
[V3] Windows workflows no longer reject recipe files whose drive letter case differs
[V3] Workflow review loops now stop once the reviewer approves instead of running to their limit
[V3] Workflows now run when your organization disables the Auto model instead of failing
Pressing Tab after `/model ` shows `set-current-as-default` as a sub-command again, instead of listing it as a model in the model picker
[V3] `/code summary` now generates codebase documentation from the code intelligence overview instead of failing
[V3] Sandbox network rules now match host names regardless of letter case
[V3] On Windows, hook commands no longer run a same-named program from the working directory
